description_en: Modifies the description of an Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-instance-remark --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --remark new-remark --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceRemark

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的DDoS高防实例的ID。

parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the instance.

The value can contain letters, digits, and some special characters, such as`, . + - * / _` The value can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
为DDoS高防实例设置备注。

支持使用中文字符、英文大小写字符、数字及部分特殊字符，例如：`,.+-*/_`。最长不允许超过500个字符
